title: Maximum sum of non adjacent elements
statementHtml: Given an integer array nums of size n. Return the maximum sum possible using the elements of nums such that no two elements taken are adjacent in nums.
examples:
Input: nums = [1, 2, 4]

Output: 5

Explanation:

[1, 2, 4], the underlined elements are taken to get the maximum sum.

Input: nums = [2, 1, 4, 9]

Output: 11

Explanation:

[2, 1, 4, 9], the underlined elements are taken to get the maximum sum.
